name: paypay2mfjs
description: Automates importing PayPay CSV transactions into Money Forward ME with a local Windows tool.
_comment: node-domexception@1.0.0 (via @google-cloud/firestore → google-gax → node-fetch) is deprecated but triggers no security vulnerability; upgrade deferred to future @google-cloud/firestore major version. npm WARN deprecated related to this transitive dependency is expected and acceptable for now.
